observations: Truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a white Nissan Diesel truck.
The truck has right-hand steering and a 'NO HAND SIGNAL' sign on the front.
The drilling rig is painted orange; the mast is in the horizontal transport position.
A stylized black logo is visible on the side of the mast in photos 0 and 1.
Hydraulic hoses, tanks, and control valves are visible on the left side of the rig in photo 1.
A few drill pipes are visible on a side rack in photo 0.
The truck carries a Plateau State license plate: XA 385 MKK.
Watermarks 'LOVE PAUL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear on all images.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the rig and truck in operation.
Cannot verify mechanical readiness for immediate work remotely.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system or drill head failure
risks.proof: Video of the mast raising, lowering, and the drill head rotating.
Video of the truck engine starting and the vehicle driving.

risks.risk: Unknown drilling depth and torque capacity
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the drilling rig.

risks.risk: Incomplete drill string (missing pipes and bits)
risks.proof: Photo of all included drill pipes, hammers, and bits laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the drilling rig showing model and capacity.
Video of the drilling rig operating (mast lifting and drill head rotation).
Video of the truck engine running and the truck being driven.
Photos of all drill pipes and accessories included in the sale.
response.reason: The specific model and capacity of the drilling rig, which are the primary value drivers, are not visible. A video of the machine in operation is required to verify the seller's claim of it being 'working fine'.
